method: Targeted archival source identification. Rows correspond to distinct material or source-accession tasks, NOT 27 extra customs or 27 independent research observations. SIUSA national inventory is an archivist's description, not facsimiles of original 1761–1905 material. Printed Pitrè books are bibliographically identified; original text sections uninspected. Salemi 1779 account is reported by a local museum, and its exact shelfmark is not located. Future source promotions require actual physical/digital document inspection, document folio and direct original passage.
repository_scope: REGIONAL_ITALIAN_HISTORY_ONLY; do not duplicate household-author or Spanish regional parallel intake
